title: Asking for Help
description: Learn essential Hindi phrases for emergencies — asking for help, calling police, and getting assistance.

exercises.explanation: Emergency phrases — 'madad karo' (help me) and 'police bulao' (call the police) are the most critical.

exercises.question: How do you shout 'help!' in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Madad karo!' = help me! This is the word to shout in an emergency. 'Bachao!' is also used.
'Police bulao' = call the police. 'Bulao' = call/summon (imperative). In India, the emergency number is 100.
'Yahaan ruko!' = stop here! 'Ruko' = stop (casual). 'Rukiye' = please stop (polite).
'Mujhe madad chahiye' = I need help. 'Madad' = help, 'chahiye' = is needed.

exercises.question: You're in a wrong taxi. How do you say 'stop the car here'?
exercises.explanation: 'Yahaan gaadi roko' = stop the car here. Gaadi = car/vehicle, roko = stop, yahaan = here.
'Madad karo!' = help me! Madad = help, karo = do (imperative). Two words, possibly the most important in this course.
'Main kho gaya hoon' = I'm lost (masculine). Woman says 'main kho gayi hoon'. 'Kho gaya' = got lost.
exercises.hint: sounds like: main kho guh-yaa hoon
